name: agent-watch
description: Subagents at a glance: tokens per agent, a toast when one stalls, and a summary naming the heaviest agent when they finish

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Track subagents: tokens per agent, stall and summary toasts, the status line and the pane. Off keeps only the /watch command, which turns it back on. /watch on and off change it too; /watch hide keeps it on but silent

stallMinutes.title: Stall after (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A running agent with no model request or tool call for this long is flagged as stalled

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane, the status line and the toasts. auto follows the system's LANG: Portuguese for pt_*, English otherwise and when LANG is unset

icons.title: Icons in the terminal
icons.description: emoji draws the stall warning as ⚠; symbol draws it as ! for terminals that draw it at odd widths; auto uses symbol in a JetBrains IDE's terminal and emoji elsewhere
